rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The Communication Department's highlights dated 10 August 2019 report that at the Working Committee meeting held that day all members unanimously urged Rahul Gandhi to remain Congress President and lead the party.

locator.item: Hindi summary, first paragraph; English summary, first paragraph

rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The same highlights report that Rahul Gandhi thanked the members but said his decision not to withdraw his resignation was final, and asked for a wider consultation (five sub-groups met PCC Presidents, CLP leaders, AICC Secretaries and MPs that day).

locator.item: English summary, first and second paragraphs

rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: Asked whether the Working Committee had accepted the resignation, Shri Surjewala said (Hindi) that it had not: the resignation of Congress President Rahul Gandhi was still under the Working Committee's consideration, no decision had yet been taken on an interim or a final President, and the Working Committee would meet again at 8 pm.

locator.item: Hindi answer to the question on acceptance; English answer

rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The same highlights still style him 'Congress President Shri Rahul Gandhi' and call Sonia Gandhi the 'former Congress President'.

locator.item: English summary, second and last paragraphs
